description: This Java class 'AIMPaymentServices' provides integration with the Authorize.Net AIM payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction processing, with handling for different response codes and transaction types.

classes.name: AIMPaymentServices
classes.description: A Java class providing methods to interact with Authorize.Net AIM payment gateway, including authorization, capture, refund, release, and transaction validation.

methods.name: isVoidableResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response code indicates the transaction can be voided based on predefined response code lists.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction with the payment gateway.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Performs a capture of a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund; attempts to void the original transaction if refund fails and conditions are met.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) an authorized transaction.

methods.name: voidTransaction
methods.description: Helper method to void a transaction given an authorization transaction.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Unsupported operation, returns an error indicating credit is unsupported.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture in a single step.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Handles the actual HTTP request to the payment gateway for a transaction.

methods.name: isTestMode
methods.description: Checks if the system is running in test mode based on configuration.

methods.name: buildAIMProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the payment request based on context and gateway settings.

methods.name: buildMerchantInfo
methods.description: Adds merchant credentials and related info to the request.

methods.name: buildGatewayResponeConfig
methods.description: Configures response format settings for the request.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Adds billing information to the request from context data.

methods.name: buildEmailSettings
methods.description: Adds email notification settings to the request.

methods.name: buildInvoiceInfo
methods.description: Adds invoice and description info to the request.

methods.name: buildAuthTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the request data for an authorization transaction.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the request data for a capture transaction.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the request data for a refund transaction.

methods.name: buildVoidTransaction
methods.description: Prepares the request data for voiding a transaction.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the request data before sending to the gateway.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response from an authorization request and populates results.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response from a capture request.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response from a refund request.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Processes the response from a release (void) request.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes combined auth and capture response.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Converts internal card type identifiers to gateway-specific codes.

methods.name: getXAmount
methods.description: Extracts the amount from the request map.
